title: Kid Howard's Silver Leaf Brass Band
summary: Played the wakes with Kid Howard's brass band; he lists its members and says he played bass drum.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Kid Howard played each one. I was working with Kid Howard's band at the time. He had a regular brass band? Oh, yes. He had a regular brass band. And the name of his band was the Golden Leaf, the Silver Leaf Brass Band. That's it. Silver Leaf Brass Band. Remember who was in that band? Yeah, I'll see if I can call some of the fellas. Kid Howard was the leader. Sheik. Thomas Jefferson, that's the three trumpet players. Jim Little played bass. Jim Crow played trombone. Homer Eugene played trombone. I was in the band. I was in the band. Handy played sax. I was on the bass drum. Bat was on the snap drum. That's about all I can think of right now. Was that clarinet player, did you say? Yeah, I'm trying to think, yeah, I'm trying to think, just whether it was George or who played, I don't remember now, but just who played clarinet on those two jobs.
